definitions.scope: All525+900 original frames, two original archived trials per arm/eight histories. Targets are exactly original lost-active common inputs whose frozen past bridge category is missing_reference_support or unbridged_known_chains. Fixed2/0 and1/1 expected counts; mismatch fails source/null, no case replacement or outcome-based selection. Four event boundaries are not necessarily four physical incidents, independent samples or independent confirmation.
definitions.time: Evidence query at frame f accesses only Timeline committed through f-1 plus the validated before_update role. All births, accepted updates, cross-arm birth-input actions and removal records must have t<f. Snapshot evidence before current graph/timeline commits. Current accepted event identifies the previously frozen boundary and has a separate result pane; it never anchors itself. The entire suffix f+1..source-end is descriptive, never repairs the prior snapshot.
definitions.birth: Immutable within-arm birth(frame,index) receipt and original unmatched-high reason; birth is NOT an accepted observation or identity anchor. At the same past seed input in the other arm, record birth, accepted_high/weak (owner/predecision role), unaccepted or missing_evidence. Same source input verified by original receipts, not box/ID similarity. No inferred reason for unaccepted inputs and no parameter/eligibility adjustment.
definitions.accepted: Record all original pre-f owner accepted updates, including high/weak, active/retained and tentative/confirmed roles. Keep empty history separate from missing birth/evidence. Retrieve every direct past graph neighbor and its own birth/accepted/removal evidence; graph includes retired owners, not merely current competitors. Native tokens identify owners only within one arm, never join arms.
definitions.expiry: Require complete explicit before_lifecycle_prune minus after_update removal receipts and recorded reason expired/immature_unmatched/expired_and_immature; never infer expiry from absence, age, lack of an update or a future deletion. No lifetime threshold recomputation or change. Query live owners as active/retained x confirmed/tentative; removed neighbors retain explicit prior reason. No prior removal means only no recorded removal through f-1. End-of-source live owners are censored, not expired.
definitions.suffix: Keep each target pair fixed. For every later common input, record original causal graph category/role/stage for that pair, or changed counterpart touching either owner; separately count later per-arm high/weak owner updates and source-end removal/censoring. Read complete suffix, no fitted window. Cases may share owners and suffixes, so these are case-exposures, not unique events/people or independent trials. Current frame excluded from all following counts.
definitions.integrity: Strict original AcceptedLedger and native uncompressed-history/input/event receipts; complete previous bridge summary/ordered receipt and previous accepted-event memberships must match. Two archived repeats independently read with identical complete raw case receipt and aggregate. Verify434 original files and all prior public/code seals before/after; pickle hash only. No GT/scores/media/cache/evaluator/solver/inference/tracker execution or tuning. No weak continuation, geometry, confirmation/buffer or default change.
definitions.failure: Refuse overwrite/retry. Source failures retain null results and local exceptions. Keep26 source rows,20 out-of-scope nulls/four old failures nulls, incomplete discovery/eight false formal replication flags and both failed original active proxies. No retrospective gate relaxation, new identity/quality acceptance or intervention.
definitions.publication: Only source/category aggregate counts, denominators, roles/stages, nulls/statuses and hashes. No per-case frame, input, birth/owner/token/ID, box, raw update/removal histories or local paths. Raw cases stay ignored local.
